description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token, with the trend statistics agents need (first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction, volatility). Polymarket services here show a snapshot of the book; this shows where the odds have been, which is what a momentum or mean-reversion decision needs. Params: token (numeric outcome token id), interval (1m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, max; default 1d), fidelity (minutes, 10-1440), limit (points, default 500).
name: x402-poly-history
